title: fix(metadata)!: store, read and remove permission sets by (package, name) (ADR-0150 D3/D4)
body:
_Requested by **Yibo Wang** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01BVUyyPie8gHwoPM18iABwB?thread=cmsg_01BVUyyPie8gHwoPM18iABwB8iGJUvUGWwxyRtRNYd9Cek)_ Fixes #32162 Clause-②: yes (narrowing) Metadata-protocol: narrowed Skills-docs: none — `skills/objectstack-platform/SKILL.md` already says permission sets "are identified by package and name"; no `skills/**` or `content/docs/**` line states that a permission-set name is unique across packages. Claim 6772659810 by `domain:server#4`; step-0 rulings Q1, Q2 and Q3 approved as recommended in amendment 6772880392. Reader/store card under epic #31527 (ADR-0150 D3/D4). Built on #32198's removal rule (PR #32274, merged as 8080763c) without forking it. ## 维护者速读 - 改了什么：权限集（`permission`）按 (package, name) 存、读、删。元数据服务里每个包的同名权限集各占一个槽；`/meta/permission/:name` 的四种读法（裸读、`?package=`、`/meta/permission/:ns/:name`、`_env`）走同一个按包解析器；删除沿用 #32198 的按包删除规则。另外三处写入方现在带上包：`AppPlugin` 注册权限集时打上本栈的 `_packageId`（制品入口本来就这么打）；安全目录回显在存储行改绑包后按包删掉旧回显槽，不再留下两个槽；保存门读「已持有的授权」时只读本次写入所在包自己的那一份。 - 为什么改：ADR-0150 D3/D4。之前两个包有同名权限集时，内存里只剩最后注册的那一份，`?package=` 读任一个包都拿到同一份内容。 - 风险与回滚：只有一个包持有的名字，答案不变。仓内第一方包没有两个包同名的权限集（普查 0 对），安装门仍拒绝第二个持有者。回滚即还原本 PR。 - 先看：`packages/metadata/src/package-slotted-store.ts`、`packages/objectql/src/package-scoped-read.ts`、`packages/runtime/src/app-plugin.ts` 的打包标、`packages/plugins/plugin-security/src/security-catalog-echo.ts` 的 `servedSlotsOf` / `dropEcho`、`packages/metadata-protocol/src/protocol-save-door-refusals.ts` 的 `heldGrantObjects`。 - 两分钟验证：`pnpm --filter @objectstack/objectql exec vitest run --maxWorkers=2 src/package-scoped-exact-qualifier.test.ts`，预期全部通过。 - 需要你做的：无，席位落地。 ## What changes - **Store (`@objectstack/metadata`)**: `permission` joins `PACKAGE_SLOTTED_STORE_TYPES`. An item stamped with a package gets its own slot; a bare read of a name two packages' slots hold refuses `409 RESOURCE_CONFLICT` naming both. Removal is #32198's `storeRemovalKeys`, unchanged: `unregister(type, name, { packageId })` and `unregisterPackage` remove only that package's slot and only a loader row that holds its set. - **Read (`@objectstack/objectql`)**: `permission` joins `PACKAGE_SCOPED_READ_TYPES`, so `SchemaRegistry.resolveItem` and the protocol's `readMetaItem` resolve the four `/meta` read forms by `(package, name)`. A name one package holds is served exactly as before at the bare address and at its holder's qualified addresses. `guest_portal` (platform-requested by name) keeps one holder per deployment and resolves from any caller. - **The census callers that must pass a package** (step 0, `32162-step0.md`): - Row 8 / Q1, `@objectstack/runtime` `app-plugin.ts`: the stack security registrar stamps `_packageId` (the stack's own package, the id `registerApp` installs it under) on each `permission` item it registers, unless the item already carries one. Without it, `new AppPlugin(stack)` compositions (`os serve`, `os dev`, `DevPlugin`, `verify bootStack`) put two packages' same-named sets in one bare slot, and `?package=` of either was served the set registered last. The other security fields keep their bytes. - Row 1 / Q2, `@objectstack/plugin-security` `security-catalog-echo.ts`: the echo reads the name's served slots (`servedSlotsOf`: a bare `get`, and on a two-holder refusal one `get` per candidate package). It drops each stale echo slot with `unregister(type, name, { packageId })` before writing the owner's slot, and it still skips when any non-echo slot holds the name. A re-bound set therefore never leaves two slots, and the next save of the name does not fail `409`. - Row 9 / Q3, `@objectstack/metadata-protocol` `protocol-save-door-refusals.ts`: `unknownGrantObjectSaveRefusal` takes the saving package. Its held-grants read is `readMetaItem({ type: 'permission', name, packageId })`; a `PackageScopedNameRefusedError` (that package holds no set of the name while another does, or a package-less save of a two-holder name) reads as nothing held. So the exemption for already-held grants never borrows another package's grants. Save passes `landsIn`, publish passes `promoteInto`, restore passes its `binding`. - Rows 7 (core `security-catalog.ts` `fromMetadata`) and 11 (plugin-security `packaged-permission-set-lock-gate.ts`) are outside the surface and need no change from this card (step 0 gives the reasons). Row 7's comment "The metadata service reads by name only" goes stale; it is reported, not edited. ## Why ADR-0150 D3/D4: a permission set is addressed by `(package, name)`. On `main`, two packages' same-named sets shared one in-memory item, the last registered, so every package's address served the same grants. ## Tests - `packages/objectql/src/package-scoped-exact-qualifier.test.ts`, new describe "permission: the four `/meta` read forms by `(package, name)`", on the real `SchemaRegistry`: - two holders: the bare read is 409 naming both; each holder's `?package=` read serves its own grants; a non-holder `?package=` is 409; the namespace form; `_env` is 409; - CONTROL one holder: bare, `?package=`, the namespace form, an `_env` environment item, and zero holders; - one-holder narrowing: `?package=` of a non-holder and `_env` of a package-held name are 409; - `guest_portal`: bare, cross-closure resolve, a second holder refused. - The registry's one-holder security-catalog rule (until #31698 PR-2) is simulated away with a spy, so the pins run on two real holders. `package-scoped-e8-readers.test.ts` lists `permission` as wired. - `packages/metadata/src/metadata-manager-match-endpoint.test.ts`: #32198's describe iterates `PACKAGE_SLOTTED_STORE_TYPES`, so every one of its pins now runs for `permission` too. One named pin is added for card Do 3: uninstalling P1 leaves P2's same-named set, with its own grants, in the store and in the loader rows. - `packages/runtime/src/app-plugin.manifest-security-collision.test.ts`: on a real `MetadataManager` with two `AppPlugin`s, each package's read serves its own body; the bare read refuses; a one-package CONTROL; a pre-stamped item keeps its stamp; `position` stays unstamped. Two existing runtime tests that compared the registered set field for field now expect the one added key, `_packageId`. - `packages/plugins/plugin-security/src/security-catalog-echo.test.ts`: re-bind P→Q leaves one slot; two pre-existing echo slots are each deleted by package; a declaration beside an echo is kept; CONTROL. - `packages/metadata-protocol/src/protocol.unknown-grant-object-refusal.test.ts`: with alpha and beta holding the name, a save by alpha exempts only alpha's held grants; gamma and a package-less save exempt none; CONTROL one holder; a non-refusal error is rethrown; door wiring for save, publish and restore (the saving package) and an environment save (`null`). ## Acceptance notes - **#32076 / PR #32277** (still open): its derived set is `PACKAGE_SCOPED_TYPES` minus `PACKAGE_SCOPED_READ_TYPES`, so `permission` leaves it on its own when this lands. If this lands first, #32277's merge needs no list edit; if #32277 lands first, this branch merges `main` and re-runs the objectql pins. Both PRs touch `security-catalog-echo.test.ts` and `protocol.unknown-grant-object-refusal.test.ts`, so whichever lands second expects a test-file merge. - **One-holder rule stays**: the install door still refuses a second permission-set holder until #31698 PR-2 narrows it to the namespace. So the two-holder answers here are reachable today only through the one-holder narrowing arms (a qualified read naming a non-holder), which the changeset's BREAKING item 2 states. - **Residue carried by #32246**: #32198's "door `MemoryLoader` still serves the body registered last" pin now runs for `permission` too, as today's state. - ⛔ `packages/spec/**` and #32164's plugin-security files are not touched. ## Verification Final tree at `cc15088f` (`main` merged at 60b99f8f; the local WIP commits were squashed into one commit on `main` with the tree byte-identical to the tested head). Every heavy run is under `scripts/pm/os-verify-lock.sh`.
Build, suites, typecheck, lint - `pnpm build`: 119/119 tasks, lock VERDICT command-exit 0. - Full suites after the `main` merge: | package | test files | tests | |---|---|---| | `@objectstack/metadata` | 71/71 | 1049 passed | | `@objectstack/objectql` | 584/584 | 12076 passed | | `@objectstack/metadata-protocol` | 332 passed, 5 skipped (337) | 22665 passed, 29 skipped | | `@objectstack/plugin-security` | 258/258 | 6241 passed, 45 skipped | | `@objectstack/runtime` | 577/577 | 9627 passed, 19 skipped | - #32198's two pinned files with `permission` in the set plus the named Do 3 pin: 173 passed. - `pnpm --filter typecheck` for the five packages: each exit 0. - Root eslint (`--no-inline-config`) over the changed `.ts` files: exit 0.
Ablations (before the main merge, through scripts/ablation-replace.mjs) Each leg went red and was restored to its HEAD blob with `git diff HEAD` empty. | leg | mutation | red | |---|---|---| | A | `permission` removed from `PACKAGE_SCOPED_READ_TYPES` | objectql 6/128 | | B | `permission` removed from `PACKAGE_SLOTTED_STORE_TYPES` (metadata dist rebuilt, `ablation-dist-preflight` found the marker in 4 dist files; `--absent` clean after restore) | runtime 2/9 | | C | the `AppPlugin` stamp off | 3 | | D | the save door ignores the saving package | metadata-protocol 2/24 | | D2 | the refusal catch in `heldGrantObjects` removed | 2 | | E | the stale-echo drop removed | plugin-security 1 | | E2 | the refusal enumeration in `servedSlotsOf` removed | 2 | | F | the save path stops passing `landsIn` | metadata-protocol 1/25 |
Gates - `node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --commands`: 79 commands, run serially under the lock after the full build, each exit code recorded before any pipe. `--ran`: "79 derived famil(ies) accounted for — 79 run, 0 NOT-MEASURED". `check-plugin-teardown-shape.mjs --self-test` first exited 3 (its pinned fixture commit was not in the clone); after fetching that commit it exited 0. - The roster gates whose roster sits under a touched directory: `check:authz-resolver`, `check:error-code-casing`, `check:route-ledger-census`, `check:changeset-fixed`, each exit 0. - `check:commit-card-trailers --range origin/main..HEAD`: exit 0.
Dogfood `pnpm --filter @objectstack/dogfood test` at the final tree after the full build, under the lock: Test Files 448 passed, 3 skipped (451); Tests 3741 passed, 42 skipped (3783). Exit 0.

No formatter ran; root eslint is clean on the changed files (`pnpm lint` is CI's). - [x] 4. One issue, one branch (merged with `main` at 60b99f8f), one PR. - [x] 5. The changeset bumps metadata, objectql, metadata-protocol, plugin-security and runtime, with its BREAKING list, FROM → TO lines, ADR-0087 disposition and both declaration lines. - [x] 6. Not applicable (`packages/spec` untouched). - [x] 7. No hand edits to generated docs or changelogs. - [x] 8.
